name: Rachell Mamalera
original_name: レイチェル・ママレーラ
source:
Border's partner.
As Border's lover she has good understanding.
Has been lover for a long time, she give a "wife who support her husband from behind" vibes.
She accepts Border's right to embrace his opponent's partner as "the right of a man who risked his life in fight."
Also for the sake of her beloved Border, she prepared to be embraced by the man who defeats him.
